displayName: CA115 - Step-up MFA for Sensitive Resources (Pilot)
description: Pilot pattern for authentication context: privileged actions tagged in target resources (SharePoint sites, Defender for Cloud Apps session controls, Purview labels, custom apps) with the authentication context value c1 are stepped up to phishing-resistant MFA before access is granted. Authentication context references (c1..c25) must be created in the Entra portal under Protection > Conditional Access > Authentication contexts before this policy binds them to a grant. Pair with downstream tagging in SPO/MDA/Purview to make the step-up meaningful.
